additional_clarifications.description: Abstract now defines the Gaussian layer variances, global margin, strict >2/3 confidence, same-depth teacher, joint width/weight resource C, and all positive scale schedules. Threshold size explicitly counts gates and incoming wires. Formal ceiling scope specifies the realizable-target, specified-sample-length instances used in the reduction.

Empirical appendix explicitly identifies saved matrices row-vector convention (train.py forward uses h@w); continuation is 240 additional epochs as recorded in predeclared-projected-continuation.json. Numerical claims unchanged.

scope_limit: Existing formal coverage qualifications are retained, including width-one conventions, auxiliary numerical budgets, partial supporting proofs, and limiting-order exclusions. This is an editorial and correspondence review, not a new external peer review.

publication_checks.legacy_collection_checker: Three unchanged baseline false positives: two nonstandard PDF filenames are ignored by its hard-coded paper.pdf lookup, and a mathematical expression in an unchanged research note is parsed as a Markdown link. Respecting catalog pdf_file verifies all 66 PDFs.
